descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Your table. Your polish. Your salon.

PAINT REAL NAILS, STROKE BY STROKE
Every nail is a real canvas. Pull the cap off a bottle and the brush comes out loaded with a glossy bead of polish. Lay a stroke from the cuticle to the tip and watch the bristle streaks melt into a smooth, mirror-wet lacquer. A quick flick goes on sheer, a slow confident pass lays a rich full coat, and two coats look like glass.

THE FULL MANICURE
File the free edge into any shape - square, squoval, round, oval or almond - by the angle you actually file at. Push back the cuticles, buff a natural shine, base coat, colour, top coat, then slide her hand under the LED lamp to cure it. Dotting tool, rhinestone tweezers and glitter polish for nail art.

CLEAN WORK MATTERS
Polish on the skin stays there until you clean it off with the remover stick. Wet polish smudges if you rush. Every set is scored on shape, length, cuticles, clean edges, colour, finish and nail art - and your clients tip for perfection.

A SALON FULL OF CLIENTS
Each client sits down with her own order and her own hands - grown-out nails, old chipped polish to remove, French tips, accent nails. New requests unlock day by day as your salon grows.

FREE PAINT
No orders, no score - every colour, glitter, dots and crystals, just for fun. Ring the bell and she will lift her hand to admire your work.

A BEAUTIFUL BOUTIQUE
Terrazzo floors, sage walls, brass and marble, a wall of 500 polishes and a London street outside.
